name: VIP Retention - High Value At Risk
description: Proactive, high-touch retention play for Data Cloud's High_Value_At_Risk segment (lifetime spend >= $5,000, no order in 90-270 days). Distinct from the general Winback journey: higher-value incentive, single touch, and a concierge contact option rather than an automated series.

exitCriteria.query: SELECT SubscriberKey FROM ShopStyle_Subscribers WHERE SubscriberStatus IN ('Unsubscribed', 'Sunset') OR EmailOptIn = 0

configurationArguments.notes: Offers a $50 credit + a direct concierge contact link, not a generic percent-off code, reflecting the individual's calculated lifetime value.

branches.name: Purchased
branches.criteria: EXISTS(ShopStyle_Orders WHERE SubscriberKey = Contact.SubscriberKey AND OrderDate >= Activity.EMAIL-VIP-OUTREACH.SendDate)

activities.name: Exit - Escalate to Concierge Team for Manual Outreach
